title: New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978, Chapter 47 (Property Law), Article 8 - Owner-Resident Relations (the Uniform Owner-Resident Relations Act)
verified_how: Fetched the NM OneSource chapter page (item 4408, '?iframe=true' form) in a browser on 23 September 2026: page title 'Chapter 47 - Property Law - NMOneSource.com', collection 'Current New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978', date 2026; the table of contents lists 'ARTICLE 8 Owner-Resident Relations' and 'ARTICLE 8A Rent Control Prohibition' with no repeal markers, in a chapter where recompiled and repealed articles are marked (e.g. 'ARTICLE 7E Homeowner Association (Recompiled.)').
notes: This is New Mexico's residential landlord and tenant statute (the Uniform Owner-Resident Relations Act). The consumer half of the topic is the Unfair Practices Act at NMSA 1978 ch. 57, art. 12 ('ARTICLE 12 Unfair Trade Practices', verified as present and unrepealed on https://nmonesource.com/nmos/nmsa/en/item/4423/index.do on the same date); because only one statute may be recorded per topic, the tenancy Act is recorded and the Unfair Practices Act noted here. Mobile-home tenancies sit separately in ch. 47, art. 10.
